decisions.reason: The exposure-level names do not alter report-detail identifiers; the separate identifier corrections in message 59 are already captured by this Requirement.
Changing variant exposure names does not change footer codes; message 59's separate footer-code corrections are already captured.
The exposure-name mapping does not change internal-header codes; message 59's separate header-code corrections are already captured.
The dashboard must continue displaying an exposure level, but its presentation fields and behavior remain unchanged; the per-variant exposure values are owned by the source Requirement.
Correcting variant exposure names changes report content, not the established visual-design direction or cross-variant design consistency.
The source changes variant titles only and does not modify the RR01 page-two statements tracked by this Requirement.
The exposure-name correction does not change the required explanation content, bullet format, or page-one detail level.
The per-variant exposure labels do not change which customer fields must be editable or the assessment-date behavior.
The internal-page header's coverage, style, and information categories remain unchanged; the separate header-code corrections are handled by the code-consistency Requirement.
The footer's coverage, style, information categories, and warning coexistence remain unchanged; variant-specific code corrections are tracked separately.
Variant exposure titles do not alter the inclusion, ranking, or presentation of recommended security actions.
The exposure-name mapping does not change the scoring table's required fields, presentation, or purpose.
